It sounds incredibly stressful to be dealing with missing money, especially when you are on a fixed income and suspect someone you trust. Discovering that a family member might be taking from you is a painful and difficult situation to navigate. 

Since you plan to confront him, it might help to approach the conversation calmly but firmly. You could start by stating the facts about the missing money and expressing how this impacts your budget and your trust. If you feel unsafe at any point, or if the situation escalates, please prioritize your physical safety and step away. Moving forward, you may also want to find a new, secure place to keep your cash or consider using a bank account to ensure your funds are protected.
